name: Wall of Mist
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

Uncheck a Condition. If you did, you create a wall of mist within far range that is 20 ft high, 15 ft thick, and up to 100 ft long or a circular wall with a diameter of medium range. The wall limits sight to 15 feet. If the Condition you unchecked was Troubled or Insecure, double the height or triple the thickness of the wall.

Whenever you maintain concentration for this spell, you may move the wall or part of the wall 5 ft in any direction you choose. Wind moves the cloud, as determined by the GM.

Describe how you create the wall.
